races.verdict: Cases can be made for most of these, but LIPS FREEDOM resumed his progress when going down narrowly at Navan recently so Andrew Kinirons' 6-y-o earns the tentative nod returned to novice company. Cocofred can't have been right on his handicap debut, so he's worth another chance to get back on the up here, with Firebrand and Celtic Alliance taken to fight out minor honours. LIPS FREEDOM (GER) COCOFRED (IRE) FIREBRAND (GER)

races.display_title: Carry Out Handicap Chase
races.verdict: STONEYFORD LADY looked a big threat when unseating her rider at Ballinrobe last month so Henry de Bromhead's mare gets the nod to make amends provided she's none the worse from that spill. Kilbrin Rocco shaped well from his lower hurdling mark at Listowel recently and if translating that form back to chasing, he looks a big threat with Jack Kennedy booked. The frustrating Presenting Lad looks best of the rest. STONEYFORD LADY (IRE) KILBRIN ROCCO (IRE) PRESENTING LAD (IRE)
